New Patients

Your First Visit

Designed Around You

Welcome to The House of Dental. Your first visit begins with a conversation — we take the time to fully understand your unique wants and needs before any treatment is planned. Expect fully digital scans, a comfortable environment, and a team that explains everything in plain terms.

Whether you’re due for a cleaning or considering a complete smile transformation, your care will be customized from the very first appointment.

Insurance & Financing

Stress-Free Payment Options

Our team helps you maximize your dental benefits and takes the stress out of the investment process. Whatever the service — full arch implant dentures, root canals, cleanings, Invisalign®, or cosmetic treatments — our priority is high-value, top-quality care.

In-Network

Insurance We Accept

We are in-network with virtually every major dental PPO plan, and our team will always work to maximize your available benefits. We also accept CareCredit®, all major credit cards, personal checks, money orders, and cash.

No Insurance? No Problem

The In-Office Savings Plan

A simple annual membership for patients without dental insurance. Preventive care is covered, major treatment is discounted, and there are no deductibles, no claim forms, and no annual maximums.

These are two separate plans, not tiers. Choose the plan that best fits your care needs.

Basic

$425/year

$871 in covered care

  • Healthy Cleanings — 2 per year$243
  • Exams — 1 annual periodic, 2 emergency$273
  • X-rays — 4 bitewings + anterior PAs yearly, panoramic every 3 years$301
  • Fluoride — 2 per year$54

10% off all major treatment

Periodontal Plus

  • Healthy Cleanings or Perio Maintenance — 4 per year$468
  • Exams — 1 annual periodic, 2 emergency$273

10% off all major treatment

Discounts exclude whitening, orthodontics, and Botox. Gum maintenance and basic prophylaxis cannot be combined; a maximum of four hygiene visits per year is covered by the plan. Plans are not valid with any other offer, special, or insurance. Membership renews on the first of the month of the following year — please call us before your renewal date if you wish to cancel.
